Name: Handsome Mature Wizard
Author: AirynS
Description:
Changes the Wizard’s portraits to a more handsome style that’s still vanilla-friendly and matches how old he looks in the default game.

Created for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/15599024]ariasonata[/url]! Please check out her mods!

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]:

[list=1]
[*]Download the mod and unzip it.
[*]Place the “[CP] Handsome Mature Wizard” in your Mods folder.
[*]Run the game once to generate a config file OR use GMCM to configure your settings.
[*]Choose whether you’re using Romanceable Rasmodius, Looking for Love, or neither (vanilla). Default setting is vanilla.
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]:

This mod includes portraits that are compatible with Romanceable Rasmodius and Looking for Love - if you are using either of those mods, please make sure to set the WizardModCompatibility setting to the correct option and select custom portraits in either RR or LFL’s config.

If you are using Diverse Stardew Valley and would like a version that includes seasonal outfits, mermaid pendants, and spirit familiars, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23918]DSV Additional Characters - Townspeople[/url]!

[b]This mod is not compatible with SVE and I will not offer compatibility for it.[/b] Posts asking about SVE compatibility will be deleted. You are free to create your own compatible version for personal use, but do not upload or share it.
